description: This file defines the UserAPI class for administrative user management within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations—getting, listing, creating, updating, and deleting users—along with associated validation rules and auxiliary parameter handling. The class interacts with user service layers, handles API request/response, and incorporates Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: UserAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for user management in the admin context, utilizing various traits and service layers to handle user data and enforce validation rules, with integrated OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single user by ID, returning a UserModel wrapped in EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all users matching filter criteria, returning a collection result with total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user based on request body parameters and persists it via UserService.

methods.name: setUserParams
methods.description: Sets user attributes from request parameters, optionally updating the password.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing user identified by ID, with optional password change.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing users.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a user.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Constructs common validation rules for user creation and update request bodies.

methods.name: getUserCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates a unique property validation option for userName, ignoring deleted entries.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing user by ID, applying validations and saving changes.
